questions.prompt: Break-even percent for a call of $25 into $75 is…
You have 9% equity and the price requires 25%. A pure call is…

choices.text: Not justified on pot odds alone.
Profitable because 9 is an odd number.

questions.explanation: Nine percent does not clear a twenty-five percent price.

questions.prompt: Betting can be better than calling when…

choices.text: You have no hand and no fold equity.
Fold equity or protection adds value you do not get by only calling.
You are facing an all-in and cannot bet.

questions.explanation: If they can still fold or you deny their equity, betting is a different action from calling.

choices.text: I called because the price was right, and this time I lost.
I will review the price, not the one outcome.
I lost, so the call was wrong and I should chase it back.

questions.explanation: Chasing a single loss is not a pot-odds calculation.
